name: fritzgate
description: 🏠 Binding Fritz thermostats with third-party thermometers

paragraphs: FritzGate turns an Ai Thinker board into a smart thermostat controller. It works with thermostats connected to a FRITZ!Box (FRITZ!DECT 301 and FRITZ!DECT 302) and uses any of 70+ Bluetooth temperature sensors for precise room temperature control. Supported vendors include Govee, Xiaomi, Qingping, Ruuvi, Inkbird, SwitchBot and ThermoPro. [](
features: FRITZ!Box integration: FritzGate reads your thermostats directly from the FRITZ!Box. It changes only the temperature offset and leaves weekly plans and all other thermostat settings alone.

External temperature sensors: A thermostat measures the temperature at the radiator. Bind it to a sensor placed in the room, and FritzGate keeps correcting the thermostat's temperature offset so the room reaches the…
Embedded web interface: Monitor temperature, humidity, battery and signal of nearby sensors, and manage thermostat-sensor bindings in the browser.
